description: Change which account notifications Sequenzy emails the API key's own user for this company. Requires the companies:manage scope. Useful before a bulk import or a large migration, when per-signup notifications would otherwise flood the inbox, or to turn the Monday weekly report off (it is on by default only for the workspace owner; invited members set weekly_report to 'weekly' to receive it), or to opt in or out of the account health check's findings (account_health 'instant' or 'off'). Modes are 'off', 'instant' (one email per occurrence), 'daily' (one summary per day), and 'weekly' (the Monday report); 'daily' is only valid for new_subscriber, because a campaign finishes once and each form submit is its own lead, and 'weekly' is only valid for weekly_report; account_health accepts only 'off' or 'instant'. Instant form-submission notifications stop after 50 per workspace per UTC day. New-subscriber notifications already fall back to a daily summary automatically on high-volume days, and imports never trigger them at all.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

notificationPreferences.description: Preferences to set. Events not listed keep their current value.

mode.description: How to receive it. 'daily' is not supported for form_submitted or campaign_completed. weekly_report accepts only 'off' or 'weekly'; account_health only 'off' or 'instant'.

name: update_notification_preferences

supportedModes.description: Modes each event accepts, keyed by event. form_submitted and campaign_completed do not accept daily; weekly_report accepts only off or weekly; account_health only off or instant.
